criteria.requirement: Add Logger.sink_context(sink, **add_options) yielding the actual new handler id and removing only that handler on every exit, including BaseException, using existing queue/file/coroutine remove/stop ownership semantics. Nested contexts and external early removal are supported; caller streams remain open as add/remove already promise. Normal cleanup failure propagates. If body and cleanup both fail, preserve the original body exception and emit a RuntimeWarning for cleanup; do not silence body failures or delete unrelated handlers. Existing queued records finish through normal remove before exit.

comparison: 依据真实程序行为接受等价实现，不按参考文本或篇幅评分。
